title: Production class-group Wasm artifact
objective: Package the qualified class-group Wasm reactor as an authenticated lazy Sage.js specialist artifact with a default factory, 256 MiB bound, and real package/browser lifecycle tests

oracles: Qualified Node, Chromium, Firefox, and WebKit row-6 receipts

handoff.summary: Packages a discoverable class-group reactor as a lazy authenticated flint-wasm specialist, generates its receipt in the normal build, enforces a 256-page initial/4096-page maximum memory contract in both build and runtime loaders, provides default packaged artifact URLs, and hardens initialization abort, worker crash recovery, session invalidation, and lifecycle tests.
risks: The dependent class-group-rust-core lane does not yet emit packages/class-groups/dist/class-group-core.wasm, so the real product-worker test is intentionally skipped and the full flint-wasm build fails closed until that reactor lands.

The architecture-owned Wasm capability registry must classify the new conditional-cubic specialist before production-capabilities can advertise it; this lane leaves the module capability list empty rather than bypassing the reject-unclassified gate.

pnpm test:changed reached pnpm build and stopped on a pre-existing numerical production-manifest toolchain identity mismatch. pnpm test:portable ran 205 of 229 files successfully, then stopped on the base branch's stale modular q-expansion freeze for architecture/package-graph.json. These are outside this lane's claims.
next_steps: After class-group-rust-core lands, build the reactor at packages/class-groups/dist/class-group-core.wasm with ABI v1 and memory initial=256/max=4096 pages, then rerun class-group-core-product.test.mjs without a skip.
The integration lane must add and review the conditional-cubic specialist capability in architecture/wasm-capabilities.json and then advertise that accepted ID from production-capabilities.json.
Rerun pnpm test:changed and the distribution lane's portable/native/SEA gates after the integration branch reconciles its existing numerical manifest and modular q-expansion source-freeze drift.
